name: remove_asks
title: Removing a row the person entered asks on a card, and goes only on the yes

steps.reply:
I've set up a **Food log** in a new Food module. There's also a chart of your calories per day.

To log something, just tell me what you ate, for example *"two eggs and toast for breakfast"* or *"had a latte at 3"*. I'll fill in the time, the meal and the amount. I'll also estimate calories, protein, carbs and fat. Estimates are marked as estimates, and if you give me numbers from a label I'll use those.

Is there anything you're tracking toward, like a calorie or protein target, or watching a particular food? If you tell me, I can show how each day compares.

I've logged 2 eggs as a snack at 23:36 tonight.

The numbers are estimates, assuming large eggs cooked without butter or oil: about **144 kcal**, with 12.6 g protein, 0.8 g carbs and 9.5 g fat. If you fried them in butter or oil, or ate them earlier as a meal, tell me and I'll change the entry.

steps.say: remove the eggs from the log
steps.reply: I took the two eggs from tonight out of your food log. It was the only entry, so the log is empty now.

checks.why: 2 asked entries: Remove "Eggs" from Food log? It leaves the table; Activity keeps that it was here..
